name: Crystal River Flowing Upward Through a Tower of Bells
description: A crystal-clear river that defies gravity, flowing upward through a tower composed of thousands of delicate glass bells, each bell catching light and producing soft chimes audible as visual glimmers.
prompt: Crystal river flowing upwards through a tower of crystal bells, each bell transparent and shimmering, water droplets glint, light passes through, creating rainbows, tower rises into a cloudy sky, surreal, hyperrealistic, cinematic, high resolution.
caption: Watch the river climb the bells 🎶✨ In this upside‑down wonder, every chime paints the sky.
